NCAA Replay Rule Change After Michigan's Controversial Win

The NCAA has altered its replay rules following a controversial win by Michigan. The Mid-American Conference (MAC) has appealed the result of the game, asking the NCAA and the College Football Playoff (CFP) to recognize Western Michigan as the actual winner. The specific details of the controversy and the nature of the replay rule change were not provided in the coverage.
